guest budget alone applies.
A compile has no checkpoint flag and resume counter 0, so the task fails and its chain is blocked." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="815" x="20" y="470" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c115" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=6;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;" value="Rules
guest: plan retries, one per guest failure, no backoff
infra: 10 per task, backoff 10 s doubling to 600 s
none: the task ends at once, never retried
free: nothing charged (operator_interrupt waits for the resume)
oom_killed twice in a row: escalate once, else infra exhausted
schedule_to_start: re-place, timeout doubled to 43200 s
CHECKPOINT_CORRUPT: drop the head of the two kept, none left is ARTIFACT_LOST
ARTIFACT_LOST of a cached component: rebuild once per run
Budgets reset at each resume, kept checkpoints stay
history: 6 per retry (history_events_per_retry), 8 + 6 per rebuild, 0 on end" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="300" width="300" x="865" y="78" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Two oom_killed in a row with no larger memory class: the infrastructure budget counts as exhausted.
The checkpoint flag is set, so wdf_workflow.result.exhausted gives paused, and a resume starts from r0a2 with fresh budgets.

div.div:
escalate-once applies only when the placer offers a larger class, so the guest budget alone applies.
A compile has no checkpoint flag and resume counter 0, so the task fails and its chain is blocked.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 290px; height: 1px; padding-top: 91px; margin-left: 865px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Rules
guest: plan retries, one per guest failure, no backoff
infra: 10 per task, backoff 10 s doubling to 600 s
none: the task ends at once, never retried
free: nothing charged (operator_interrupt waits for the resume)
oom_killed twice in a row: escalate once, else infra exhausted
schedule_to_start: re-place, timeout doubled to 43200 s
CHECKPOINT_CORRUPT: drop the head of the two kept, none left is ARTIFACT_LOST
ARTIFACT_LOST of a cached component: rebuild once per run
Budgets reset at each resume, kept checkpoints stay
history: 6 per retry (history_events_per_retry), 8 + 6 per rebuild, 0 on end
